name: Your property maintenance company
greeting: Hello, you're through to the property maintenance company. I'm the AI assistant on this demo line. How can I help?
summary: Your property maintenance company is a property maintenance company in Nottingham: Repairs and maintenance for homes, landlords and letting agents.

core_facts: Your property maintenance company: Repairs and maintenance for homes, landlords and letting agents, at Unit 4, Fernhill Trade Park, Nottingham NG7 (example).
Monday to Friday: 8am till 5:30pm. Saturday: 9am till 12 noon. Closed Sundays.
We cover Nottingham, Derby, Loughborough, Beeston and 2 more towns: NG5.
Emergencies, day and night: we aim to attend within 24 hours and make safe within 24.
Call-out £95 including VAT, with the first hour, then £40 a half hour. Nights and weekends: £150 for the first hour.
Gas emergency: the National Gas Emergency Service, 0800 111 999.

knowledge.a: We cover Nottingham, Derby, Loughborough, Beeston, West Bridgford and Long Eaton: NG5. Outside those, we can't send an engineer, sorry.
We do ponds.
We don't do pest control, sorry. Try the council's pest service, or a member of the British Pest Control Association.
We don't do lifts, sorry. Try the building's lift contractor.
We don't do white goods, sorry. Try the manufacturer or the shop it came from.
We don't do asbestos removal, sorry. Try a licensed contractor: the HSE keeps a register.
We work for homeowners, landlords, letting agents and housing associations.

knowledge.q: I'm a tenant: can I book a repair?
knowledge.a: Yes: tell me the address and what's wrong. If your landlord or letting agent is one of our clients, we arrange it with them; if not, we need your landlord's go-ahead first, and I can take their details.
Call-out £95 including VAT, with the first hour, then £40 a half hour. Nights and weekends: £150 for the first hour. Bigger jobs, over £500, we quote for, free.

knowledge.q: How much is it out of hours?
knowledge.a: Nights and weekends, the first hour is £150 including VAT. Emergencies, day and night: we aim to attend within 24 hours and make safe within 24.
Lockouts start from £120 including VAT. If you rent, your landlord or agent may pass the cost on to you: that is for them to decide.

knowledge.q: How much is a gas safety certificate?
knowledge.a: A landlord's gas safety record is £75 including VAT for one appliance, plus £15 for each extra one. A boiler service is £85, or £130 for both on one visit.
An electrical installation condition report starts from £150 including VAT, depending on the size of the property.
Jobs over £500 are quoted, free. Smaller repairs are charged at the call-out rate, £95 including VAT with the first hour.

knowledge.q: What time will the engineer come?
knowledge.a: We book a window rather than a time: . The engineer texts when they're on the way. Someone over 18 needs to be in.
Let us know beforehand and we'll move the visit. If nobody's in and we weren't told, there's a £45 charge for the wasted visit.
You can cancel free of charge until 5pm the working day before your visit.
Our workmanship is guaranteed for 12 months; parts carry the maker’s warranty.
Homeowners pay on completion by card or bank transfer; landlords and agents on account, within 14 days.

Yes: we're Gas Safe registered, number 512345 (example), and every engineer who does gas work carries their own Gas Safe ID card. We're registered with NICEIC. We carry £5 million public liability (example). Registered upper-tier waste carrier (example).
If we find anything that might be asbestos, we stop and arrange for it to be tested before any work goes on. The HSE's asbestos guidance explains more.

knowledge.q: Do I need to sort out parking?
knowledge.a: Please let us know about any parking restrictions; a permit or a space on the drive helps.
We’re always glad to hear from qualified engineers: take a message and the office will call back.

knowledge.q: How do I make a complaint?
knowledge.a: Tell us what went wrong and Helen Ward will look into it and call you back.
Calls on this demo line are transcribed so the team can see what was said.

knowledge.q: Am I talking to a real person?
knowledge.a: I'm an AI assistant answering for the team. If you'd rather speak to a person, I can take a message and someone will call you back.

knowledge.q: Can I see the data you hold about me, or stop your texts?
knowledge.a: Helen Ward looks after data protection, and we reply to any request within a month. To stop our texts, reply STOP or just say so.
For a power cut, ring 105: it is free and puts you through to your local network operator.

knowledge.q: Who do I ring about a burst water main?
knowledge.a: A burst main or no water in the street is for your water company: the number is on your water bill.

knowledge.q: Who do I ring about flooding?
knowledge.a: For flood warnings, ring Floodline on 0345 988 1188. If anyone is in danger, ring 999.

knowledge.q: What alarms must a landlord fit?
knowledge.a: Landlords in England must fit a smoke alarm on every storey and a carbon monoxide alarm in any room with a fixed fuel-burning appliance, like a boiler or wood burner (not a gas cooker), and repair or replace them when told they're faulty.

knowledge.q: How often does a landlord need a gas safety check?
knowledge.a: A landlord needs a gas safety check every 12 months by a Gas Safe registered engineer. It can be done from 10 months on without losing the date, so booking early costs nothing.

knowledge.q: How often do the electrics need checking?
knowledge.a: Landlords must have the electrics checked by a qualified electrician at least every five years, with an electrical installation condition report.

knowledge.q: What must a landlord do about damp and mould?
knowledge.a: For social housing in England, Awaab's Law sets time limits for landlords to look into and fix damp and mould. Any tenant can get advice from Shelter or Citizens Advice.

knowledge.q: I'm a tenant and my repairs aren't being done.
knowledge.a: Shelter or Citizens Advice can explain a tenant's rights about repairs. I can take the details of the repair for whoever looks after the property.

knowledge.q: Someone told me your bank details have changed.
knowledge.a: We never change bank details by email or text. Don't pay anything: check with us on a number you already have, and report it to Report Fraud on 0300 123 2040.
The office is closed on Sundays, but an engineer is on call for emergencies day and night.
Yes, every engineer has a basic DBS check and carries ID. You can ask to see it at the door.

knowledge.q: Someone at my door says they're from you, but I wasn't expecting anyone
knowledge.a: We only come when a visit is booked, and we text when the engineer is on the way. If nothing is booked, we haven't sent anyone: don't let them in. If you feel unsafe, ring 999; otherwise the police on 101.
